source: 搜神记 第一卷 第二章 谪仙人 / 无锋断剑与白龙鹿锁链
purpose: Seed for EP02 SC09 after EP02 SC08 formal test-mode segment. Continue the ComfyUI short-drama pipeline from the white-clothed woman noticing Wufeng, asking about its origin, and recognizing the white dragon-deer chain context.
title: 无锋来历，鹿兄昂然

continuity_from.approval_mode: Codex auto-pass test mode with user authorization
continuity_from.caveat: SC08 is approved only for pipeline validation. All four SC08 videos used Comfy StillFrameVideoFallback because Gemini-API rejected experimental file_ids I2V and Runway secret was missing.

source_grounding.anchor_after: 白衣女子见他片刻间扭动身子，摆了数个造型，心中不解。正待说话，突然看见他腰间所悬断剑，轻轻“噫”了一声。
source_grounding.adapted_summary: 白衣女子从拓拔野腰间看到断裂的无锋剑，神色微变，询问此剑从何处得来。拓拔野不再隐瞒，解释自己从深潭中捡到此剑，并因替白龙鹿打开锁链而将剑砍断。白龙鹿听到他说起自己，骄傲地走到白衣女子身前。白衣女子认出白龙鹿曾被北海十七混金索困在龙潭，指出拓拔野内力不足，所以才会折断无锋。拓拔野被说中短处，羞惭脸红，暗下决心要练出一身武功。
source_grounding.next_source_hint: 随后白衣女子向拓拔野借剑一观，断剑显露神农与空桑旧事，情绪转入白衣女子与神农往事线索。

continuity_rules: Adult-adapted Tuobaye only: age 28 to 32, rugged grey-brown rough cloth layers, rope belt, travel pouch, relic bundle, green bamboo flute, and broken Wufeng in a bamboo sheath at the right waist.

Wufeng is a plain rusty blue-grey iron sword now broken; avoid readable inscriptions in image/video unless a later dedicated insert explicitly handles non-readable engraved marks. Do not render clear Chinese text.

White-clothed woman remains adult, elegant, distant, water/rain-associated, fully clothed, and respectful. Use adult Yushiqie reference as the safest visual anchor while keeping first-meeting mystery.
White dragon-deer should look mythic and dignified, proud when stepping forward; avoid ordinary deer drift.
The emotional beats are curiosity, honest explanation, proud companion display, gentle correction, embarrassment, and resolve. Avoid sexualized framing or teen-romance coding.
Setting remains moonlit Tianhu bamboo pavilion, lake reflection, bamboo shadows, mist, and faint incense smoke.
No readable text, captions, subtitles, speech bubbles, English words, signs, plaques, or UI.
localization_rules: All planning text and eventual editing dialogue should be Chinese unless a technical field requires English.
Storyboard prompts may include intended Chinese dialogue as off-screen planning context, but must request no rendered subtitles or readable text.
I2V prompts must use silent visual generation: no synthesized speech, no lip-sync dialogue, no flute/xiao audio, no captions, no subtitles, no readable signs, no English words.
Chinese dialogue, narration, sound design, and subtitles should be added later in editing.

generation_policy.orchestration: ComfyUI only; cloud APIs must be called through Comfy workflow nodes.
generation_policy.gemini_video_mode: Do not use experimental file_ids I2V unless the Gemini-API contract probe confirms it is supported again.
generation_policy.runway_video_mode: Use Runway I2V only if RUNWAYML_API_SECRET is available; otherwise use Comfy StillFrameVideoFallback for pipeline continuity and mark it clearly.
generation_policy.review_gate: Test-mode auto-pass may be used while operator is absent, but record it clearly and preserve known quality issues.
generation_policy.secret_hygiene: Use api_key_env_path or local key indirection; do not inject plaintext keys into Comfy prompt JSON/history.
generation_policy.motion_safety: Use stable reaction shots, hand near broken sword, white dragon-deer stepping forward, subtle robe/hair/mist motion, and restrained facial reactions. Avoid lip-sync, fast body turns, or readable inscription closeups.

suggested_shots.title: 女子瞥见无锋
suggested_shots.visual_focus: The adult white-clothed woman notices the broken Wufeng sword at Tuobaye right waist; her calm eyes shift from his awkward pose to the sword, with a subtle change of expression.

suggested_shots.title: 深潭拾剑开锁
suggested_shots.visual_focus: Tuobaye honestly gestures to the broken blue-grey Wufeng at his waist, implying he found it in a deep pool and broke it while freeing his companion; keep dialogue for later edit only.

suggested_shots.title: 鹿兄昂然上前
suggested_shots.visual_focus: The white dragon-deer proudly steps forward between Tuobaye and the white-clothed woman, dignified and luminous, as if showing that it is the rescued companion.

suggested_shots.title: 内力不足暗自立誓
suggested_shots.visual_focus: The woman calmly recognizes the North Sea mixed-metal chain context and gently points out Tuobaye lacked internal power; Tuobaye blushes with embarrassment and lowers his gaze, then tightens his fist in quiet resolve.
